findings.title: drag_to==0 sentinel collides with live node id 0 — rejection (and commit) suppressed for drags onto the residential node (pre-existing, carry-forward)
findings.evidence:
app/main.odin:58 "	drag_to:       u32,    // the node the cursor is currently snapped to (0 = none)"; core/topology.odin:137-138 "	id := t.next_node_id
	t.next_node_id += 1"; app/main.odin:1057 "	r := pp.topology_spawn_node(&state.topology, res_idx, {8, 15}, cat)"; app/main.odin:383 "			app.drag_to = id"; app/main.odin:836 "	if app.drag.active && app.drag_to != 0 {"
findings.detail: next_node_id starts at 0 and seed_fixture spawns residential FIRST, so the residential node IS id 0. Snapping to it sets drag_to=0 — the 'none' sentinel — so the draw block (and the commit gate at line 406) skip entirely: an invalid host→residential terminal→terminal drag shows NO rejection (AC1's own example), and a VALID draw ending at residential can never commit. Pre-existing in v2 — the diff's hunk keeps the gate unchanged.
findings.recommended_fix: Follow-up (outside this surgical fix): distinguish no-snap from snapped-to-0 (ids from 1, or a snap-ok bool), and draw the rejection whenever valid != .None during an active drag.

findings.title: Cursor-anchored rejection clips at window edges — no clamp; the long reject labels clip earlier than the short cost label
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:839 "			draw_text(app, reject_label(app.drag.valid), i32(cur.x)+12, i32(cur.y)-14, 16, rl.Color{200, 60, 60, 255})"; app/main.odin:894 "	case .Router_Ports_Full: return "router ports full - demolish a pipe or upgrade""; app/main.odin:966-973 "draw_text :: proc(app: ^App, txt: string, x, y: i32, size: i32, col: rl.Color) { ... rl.DrawText(cstring(raw_data(cbuf)), x, y, size, col)"
findings.detail: draw_text has no clamp. Near the top edge the anchor (cur.y-14) goes negative; near the right edge the 33-46 char labels (~260-370px at 16px) extend past WIN_W=1280 where the 7-char 'cost N' fits. Inherent to the user-verified cursor-anchor pattern (the cost readout shares it), but the rejection's length makes it clip earlier. Cosmetic + transient.
findings.recommended_fix: Follow-up refinement (keeps the verified anchor): clamp y to >= 0 and flip the label left of the cursor near the right edge (or clamp x to WIN_W - text width).

findings.title: Hoisted to_screen computes cur on paths that draw nothing
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:838 "		cur := rnd.to_screen(&app.view, app.drag.wx, app.drag.wy)"; app/main.odin:841 "		} else if app.assist_mode == .Off || (app.assist_mode == .Full && !(app.preview_live && app.preview.ok)) {"
findings.detail: In Full assist with a live ok preview (or Glow_Only with valid==.None), neither branch draws yet cur is computed. A pure view transform (one multiply-add per drag frame); the PR body documents the deliberate hoist so both branches share ONE anchor definition (cannot drift). Harmless.
